detail: `type(scope): lowercase imperative description`, no trailing period, 72 characters at most.
The most affected module. Several scopes are comma-separated with no space, capped at 3, as in `fix(encryption,utils)`.
Different primary types get a proposed split with a file list per commit. The same type across several folders gives one message with combined scopes.
`docs`, `test`, and lockfiles, generated files and snapshots join another type. The body gets one `Also ...` line.
The type with more changed files wins. `test` wins a tie, and an override line shows how to switch.
A `!` after the type plus a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer that says how to adapt.
Always excluded. Run `git add` on one and pick Retry to include it.
Asked only when staged and modified files both exist or nothing is staged. Options are staged only, staged plus modified, and Retry.
The nearest ancestor branch, meaning the candidate with the fewest commits ahead of HEAD. Confirmed with you when two candidates are close.
The humanizer rules apply: no em dashes, no buzzwords, no summary sentences, nothing invented.
Text only. The skill never runs `git commit`, `git push` or opens a PR unless you ask.
